sprint.goal: Build a lightweight Kanban project management app: REST API + minimal web UI. Users can create tasks, move them between Todo, In Progress, and Done, edit task details, and delete tasks.

tasks.title: Create tasks table schema (id, title, status, created_at) in database.py
Implement REST API in server.py: create/list/update/delete tasks, move between statuses
Build Kanban board UI in index.html (3 columns, click-to-move) consuming the API

messages.content: database.py now exposes initialize_database(), get_connection(), utc_timestamp(), DATABASE_PATH, and VALID_STATUSES; tasks uses id, title, status, created_at with valid statuses todo/in_progress/done.

API ready: GET/POST /api/tasks; PATCH or PUT /api/tasks/:id; DELETE /api/tasks/:id. Tasks return id, title, status (todo|in_progress|done), created_at. POST requires title and accepts optional status; PATCH accepts title and/or status.

architecture_decisions.decision: Python stdlib http.server + sqlite3 for backend, single static HTML+vanilla JS file for frontend. No external dependencies (sandbox has no network access).
Used a SQLite CHECK constraint to restrict task statuses to todo, in_progress, and done.
Used JSON request/response bodies and PATCH for partial task edits/status moves.
Validated titles and status values at the API boundary; used parameterized SQLite statements.
